Number of studies.evidence_source: This section reviews existing literature on body image, BMI, and sexual health, discussing findings from multiple cited studies (e.g., Satinsky et al., 2012; van den Brink et al., 2016) but does not present new studies conducted by the authors of this paper.

section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses the relationship between body image, BMI, and sexual health, reviewing existing literature. It highlights inconsistent findings regarding BMI's direct impact on sexual health and emphasizes the role of appearance dissatisfaction. Two specific studies (Satinsky et al., 2012; van den Brink et al., 2016) are detailed for their examination of body appreciation's link to sexual function and satisfaction, noting conflicting results and the need for further research.
